items.title: Phil Mead interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: Interviewer introduces himself as Monk Rowe and notes they are filming for the Jazz Archive; Interviewee responds politely to the introduction.

ctx.x: Phil was interviewed in Clinton, New York on June 1, 2006 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming at Hamilton College today for the Jazz Archive. And I’m very pleased to have another Hamilton alum, Phil Mead, class of ’59, here today. Welcome.
It’s good to be here. Thanks for having me.
